title: pistacia lentiscus var. multiflora
intro: Pistacia lentiscus var. multiflora, commonly known as Mastiche or Mastich, is a variety of the Pistacia lentiscus tree, which is a small evergreen tree native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Pistacia lentiscus var. multiflora include its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and fungi, reduce inflammation and pain, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as mastichadiene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
